case.label: E
case.text: E is the shortest path to the stated goal and matches the phrase 'receives one copy of the most recent automated snapshot': the automated snapshot already exists and sharing it looks like the least operational overhead, with no extra copy step. A candidate who remembers that manual snapshots can be shared, and who does not recall that an automated snapshot must first be copied to a manual one (and that a snapshot encrypted with the AWS managed key aws/rds cannot be shared at all), could argue that E plus a key-sharing step is enough. The stem also never says that the key policy of an AWS managed key cannot be edited, so B is only ruled out by outside knowledge, not by anything in the stem. In addition, option A starts with 'the manual snapshot copy', a phrase that appears nowhere in the stem, so A only makes sense as the follow-up of D; this makes the pair easy to pick by wording alone.
